name: How to Win Girls and Influence People
source:
Hilarious, heartfelt, and totally romantic! It's the tale of Cale, a happy-go-lucky high school student who has recently moved to his hometown to live with his grandma. Follow Cale as he meets various people, including Nayuna, the tsundere who is secretly lonely, Aika, the airhead who wants to be helpful, and Hasumi, the timid girl who tries to fit in. 

Will these girls fall for Cale and his charm and wit? And who will ultimately win his heart? It's up to you to decide in this tale of friendship, romance, and comedy.

[From [url=https://rizvn.itch.io/win-girls]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
搞笑、真挚、浪漫！这是关于凯尔的故事，他是一名无忧无虑的高中生，最近搬到家乡与祖母住在一起。跟随凯尔的脚步，他会遇到各种各样的人，包括内心孤独的傲娇娜尤娜、乐于助人的傻瓜爱卡，以及试图融入社会的胆怯女孩莲实。

这些女孩会爱上凯尔和他的魅力和智慧吗？而最终谁能赢得他的心呢？在这个充满友谊、浪漫和喜剧的故事中，一切由你来决定。

[来自[url=https://rizvn.itch.io/win-girls]itch.io[/url]]
